answer: Yes, we can get it for you. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts, so if you sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, Northwind will ask Summit for the dealer payoff quote. This quote can be different from the payoff Summit gives you directly, and it's the one you'll bring to your appraisal appointment. Use NW-LSE-1, not the loan form NW-LPA-1, which only covers loans. If our offer is higher than the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference to you.
